texte: Our estate is a great family story that takes root in 1763. At that time, winegrowing was only part of the family’s resources, as they were farmers as well as winemakers. From the outset, the Gironde terroir provided the ideal setting for a quality estate.

Germaine keeps the family estate going while waiting for her husband, Rémi Coquilleau, to return from the war; he will spend five long years in a prison camp in Czechoslovakia. The young girls help out every day and the harvest carries on, despite the hardship of the war years.

From the 1960s onwards, Simon and Huguette Rey look after the estate and work tirelessly to expand the vineyard. They begin restructuring it by planting vines on the best terroirs, keeping to a focus on quality that remains the estate’s guiding principle.

The year 1973 sees the birth of the first bottle labelled “Domaine des Graves d’Ardonneau”, the result of a selection of the best grapes on the property. Simon Rey thereby gives the house its identity and its signature.
Their son, Christian, after studying viticulture, brings his expertise to the estate and joins his parents in what is already a passion.
He marries Pascale, who joins him in his life project. Year after year, they keep expanding the estate and work tirelessly to improve the quality of their wine.
Their son, Laurent, after studying oenology at the University of Bordeaux, comes to add his contribution. Both passionate and meticulous, he gives his wines their authenticity and finesse.

His sister, Fanny, having combined studies in international business with classical singing at the Bordeaux conservatoire, chooses the family adventure. She supports the project with energy, contributing to the estate’s reputation.
